explanation: Push new entries onto an incoming stack. When the outgoing stack is empty, transfer the incoming entries to reverse their order; dequeuing then removes the oldest entry. Every Queue constructor command clears both stacks so no old entries survive a reset.
timeComplexity: O(1) amortized per enqueue/dequeue operation, with O(n) worst-case transfer. Initialize releases O(n) live entries; over an operation sequence each enqueued entry is transferred or discarded at most once.
spaceComplexity: O(n) space for n live queued entries.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C++ implementation and reset-aware operation wrapper, independently authored from the public problem contract and repository-authored C# algorithm. Uses the unchanged local EPI Judge serialization and test framework APIs; upstream reference sources are not modified.
